name: Trumpeter's Service
summary: Teapot and lid with decoration depicting Middle Eastern musician, this design is known as the 'Trumpeter's Service' and may possibly have been by the Dutch designer Cornelis Pronk (1691-1759); porcelain painted in overglaze enamels and gilt; China (Jingdezhen), Qing dynasty, ca. 1740

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
